summary: This table presents the quarterly financial performance across various sectors for the periods ending December 31, 2025, September 30, 2025, and December 31, 2024. The sectors include Financial Services, Manufacturing, Energy, Utilities, Resources & Services, Retail, Communication, Hi-Tech, Life Sciences, and Others. The table also shows year-over-year (YoY) growth percentages for each sector, with the total percentage growth reported as 3.2% and 1.7% when adjusted for constant currency (CC). Notably, Financial Services shows the highest value at 28.2% for Dec 31, 2025, while Others has the lowest at 2.4%. The data indicates varying growth trends across sectors, with Manufacturing and Hi-Tech also showing significant growth rates.
